The `SSLHandshakeException` (`Trust anchor for certification path not found`) occurred because the Android app in debug mode connects to the local development server at `https://10.0.2.2:8443/`, which uses a self-signed certificate (`dev-ca/shelftap-dev-ca.pem`) not included in Android's default trusted certificate authorities.

The following changes have been made to configure Android Network Security for the dev CA:

1. Added the development CA certificate as a raw Android resource in [shelftap_dev_ca.pem](file:///mnt/01DC198BE9192500/github/Schooldev/3S-study-work/trials/e4/c2-agy-A-r2/work/app/src/main/res/raw/shelftap_dev_ca.pem).
2. Created [network_security_config.xml](file:///mnt/01DC198BE9192500/github/Schooldev/3S-study-work/trials/e4/c2-agy-A-r2/work/app/src/main/res/xml/network_security_config.xml) using `<debug-overrides>` to trust `@raw/shelftap_dev_ca` during debug builds without compromising release builds:
   ```xml
   <?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
   <network-security-config>
       <debug-overrides>
           <trust-anchors>
               <certificates src="@raw/shelftap_dev_ca" />
           </trust-anchors>
       </debug-overrides>
   </network-security-config>
   ```
3. Updated [AndroidManifest.xml](file:///mnt/01DC198BE9192500/github/Schooldev/3S-study-work/trials/e4/c2-agy-A-r2/work/app/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml#L6-L9) to reference `@xml/network_security_config` on the `<application>` element via `android:networkSecurityConfig`.
